reviews.title: A bit disappointed
reviews.text: I am finding it difficult to add all of my books that I own. The app is not recognizing some Kindle books even when I search online. I have tried using the isbn number for these books and it tells me that they are not found. I spent the $10 for these books pro hoping for a better app, but not sure if it is worth it. Maybe I will just go back to Goodreads and be done…wish I could get a refund!
